brief:
Former Tunisian President Moncef Marzouki announced plans for an expanded international mobilization supporting the Palestinian cause during September, according to Shehab Wire. He confirmed that arrangements and preparations are underway to launch what he characterized as the largest coordinated popular and international solidarity movement around Palestinian issues in the coming month. Marzouki did not specify which countries, organizations, or groups would participate in the coordination effort.

The initiative aims to concentrate global attention and grassroots support on Palestinian affairs through organized international action. Details about the scope, structure, and specific activities planned for the campaign remain unclear based on Marzouki's initial announcement to the news agency.
